chart_policy: one vocal attack per aligned syllable at audio_onset_ms; no 500ms or 1000ms density deletion; measured holds only for sustained_syllable/interjection_hold

density_policy.dense_500_ms: not collapsed; two or three Spanish syllables in 500ms remain separate attacks
density_policy.dense_1000_ms: observed only; all measured vocal attacks are preserved
density_policy.holds: only alignment kinds sustained_syllable/interjection_hold with measured hold >= 180ms, bounded by vocal end and next attack
density_policy.hard_subdivisions: added only inside measured holds >= 180ms and rechecked for collision
